title: fix(console): the AI build chat's change card names drafted objects and fields by label, and the publish-health line reads the locale pack
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XRT27U1unc64yMdYqqPWFjw)_

Part of #32984 — this PR builds split (a), labels for drafted objects and fields on the change card (acceptance 5), and split (b), the publish-health line's own words through the locale pack. The card stays open for Q1 (a customer sentence for build and publish findings) and Q2 (the label of a field a change is about to create), which other threads build.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 搭建对话里的「修改确认卡」现在用中文名称（如「报价明细 · 小计」）指代尚未发布、只存在于草稿中的对象和字段；发布后的健康提示行（「N 条示例数据已上线 · 已核对 N 个视图」）改为跟随界面语言，并按数量正确变化单复数。
- 为什么改：客户在首次发布前看到的确认卡全是 `b6bl_quote_item · line_total` 这类机器名；健康提示行在所有语言下都是英文。
- 风险与回滚：只影响 AI 对话里这张卡和这一行。确认卡对已发布名册里查不到的对象，会按名称多发一次 `?preview=draft` 读取（每个对象在每条新消息或每轮对话后最多读一次，不会每次渲染都读）。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/changeCardLabels.ts`（查不到时读草稿的逻辑）、`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` 的 `PublishHealthLine`、`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` 的 `chatbot.build.health`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/changeCardLabels.drafted-32984.test.tsx packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.needsAttention-32984.test.tsx`，预期两个文件全绿（15 个用例）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**(a) The change card names drafted objects and fields by label.** The resolvers behind the card (`resolveObjectLabel` / `resolveFieldLabel` in `ChatPane`) read only the published registry. Before an app's first publish, every object the build made lives only in the draft overlay, so the card showed machine names. The resolvers move into a new hook, `useChangeCardLabels` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/changeCardLabels.ts`). It answers in this order:

1. the published registry, by name, as before (`readObjectsByName`, so the dock still never reads the whole registry);
2. for an object the registry does not know, or a field it does not hold, the draft overlay: `metadataClient.withPreviewDrafts(true).get('object', name)`, which is `GET /meta/object/:name?preview=draft`. The answer is kept per object. When the kept answer does not name what a card asks for (no object, or not that field), the overlay is asked again once the conversation's revision has moved: `ChatPane` passes the message count plus whether a turn is running, so a field or object a later change drafts is named on the next card. At most one read per object per revision, and none while one is in flight, so a render never refetches.

A name neither world knows (one the change is about to create) still shows as given. That is Q2, not built here. Nothing else in the console reads the overlay because of this change: the hook is used only by the change card's resolvers, and the published `MetadataProvider` is untouched.

**(b) `PublishHealthLine`'s own words read the locale pack.** "N sample rows live", "N views · N widgets · N seeds verified" were hard-coded English, with an `s` chosen on `=== 1`. They are now count families under `chatbot.build.health` (`sampleRowsLive`, `views`, `widgets`, `seeds`, plus `verified` with a `{{checks}}` list), in all ten packs. Each pack carries the plural slots its language needs, following `chatbot.build.needsAttention`. zh-Hant is generated from zh-Hans (`gen:zh-hant`). The English "seed" now reads "sample data set". The findings the line lists, `seedError` and `issues[].message`, are producer text and render exactly as before. Q1 owns them.

Changeset: `.changeset/32984-build-chat-labels-health.md`, patch for `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` and `@object-ui/i18n`. The widening is new i18n keys only.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/changeCardLabels.drafted-32984.test.tsx` (8 cases): a drafted-only object and field answer their draft labels, read once through the overlay; a field drafted onto a published object answers its draft label; control: a published object answers from the registry with no overlay read; control: a name neither world knows stays undefined and is asked once. Same conversation, later change: a field added after the first read is named on a later card; an object created after the first read is named on a later card; control: a miss is re-asked at most once per revision, never per render; control: a kept answer that holds the asked field is not re-asked when the revision moves.
- `ChatbotEnhanced.needsAttention-32984.test.tsx` (the provider-backed harness for this card) gains a describe with 4 cases: zh-Hans, ru (one / few / many), en (one / other), and a control where an error's producer text passes through verbatim and the verified claim is withheld.
- `ChatbotEnhanced.test.tsx`: the English pin moves from "1 seed verified" to "1 sample data set verified".
- `AiChatPage.appliedCardDoors-12894.test.tsx` (the real `ChatPane`, with `ChatbotEnhanced` as a prop recorder) gains a describe that pins the call site's revision. The recorder resolves a card's field during its render, as the card does. The draft overlay gains the field only after the first card shows, and the conversation then moves on one message. The card reads `discount` first and `折扣` after.
- `openPathObjectReaders-12811.test.ts` (the objectui#12811 census of `useMetadata().objects` readers): the change card's by-name row moves from `AiChatPage.tsx` to `changeCardLabels.ts`, still `byName`, because the `readObjectsByName` call moved there. `AiChatPage.tsx` no longer reads objects, so the census no longer finds it. Without this move the census went red in CI on b84b2cf721 and later heads (Test UI 1/16).

## Acceptance notes

- **Reproduction.** The step-1 reading inferred the defect from code. Two readings confirm it. First, the red-first run above. Second, an in-process probe on `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` (a throwaway test, not kept): stage a draft `object` `b6bl_quote_item` with `mode: 'draft'`, then read it. The published by-name list (`getMetaItems({ type: 'object', names: [...] })`) answered `[]`. `getMetaItem({ previewDrafts: true })` answered the item with `label: 'Quote line'` and `_draft: true`, both with and without `packageId`, so the overlay read needs no package.
- **Browser look: NOT MEASURED.** A `pnpm dev -- --fresh` showcase boot was refused by `check-dev-prereqs` (41 of 107 workspace packages unbuilt; the fix is a whole-workspace `pnpm build`, which a shared container should not run for this). A change card also needs a build agent that emits `changes_proposed`, which comes from cloud.
- **A change applied later in the same conversation.** The pane is keyed by conversation, so a first overlay answer kept for the pane's life would have left every later card naming that field or object on its machine name. The kept answer is now asked again, once per object per conversation revision, when it does not name what a card asks for. Pinned red-first above. What stays as given is only a field or object no change has drafted yet (Q2: nothing built now).
- **Order of the two worlds.** For a published object whose label was changed in a draft, the card shows the published label, because the registry answers first. Reading the overlay first for every name would add one request per object on every card. This case is not closed here: it stays open on #32984 item 5 (acceptance line 5), carried in card comment 6930132262, and #32984 stays open because this PR says `Part of`.
- **Left as is (Q1's line).** `publishHealthFromResponse` (`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/publishHealth.ts`) writes its own English fallback, "Sample data failed to load.", into `seedError` when the producer sends no text. It reaches three surfaces as `seedError`. It is not touched here so this PR and Q1's do not collide on `seedError`.

## Verification

- Local derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 41 commands): 40 ran exit 0, including `check:query-options-erasure` on a rerun after a 300 s local timeout. The 41st, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`, first went red in `check-i18n-call-site-keys` and `check-i18n-dead-keys`, because the first cut built the key from a template (`chatbot.build.health.` plus a name). b84b2cf721 makes every key literal at its call site, and the two files are green.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
- Fix round (R1 and CI reds, 6cc3b3c912): the call-site revision is pinned at ChatPane level and the pin was ablated (above). The census row follows the moved reader. Type Check UI's TS2345 at `AiChatPage.appliedCardDoors-12894.test.tsx` (an `object | undefined` handed to `WeakMap.set`, from the overlay-client double) is fixed by typing the double with an early return, no non-null assertion. app-shell type-check, the test layer included, exits 0 on 6cc3b3c912. Other tests that name `AiChatPage.tsx` were grepped: none is a census of the moved resolver code, and the three that read its source run green above.
- Fix round (S1, d4a5a19c94): `check-empty-changeset`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check:nul-bytes` and `check:cross-package-test-inputs` re-run exit 0 after the changeset sentence changed; `check:new-line-citations` 0 new.
- `git merge-tree` against the open PRs touching these files (`AiChatPage.tsx`, the locale packs): no conflicts. No open PR touches `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` or `publishHealth.ts`.
- CI is the authority on the full farm.
